Sam Rivera: hey team quick qI converted from contractor to FT on 2024-02-10 and missed the open enrollment cutoff. When will my 401(k) and HSA start? Is employer match prorated for the partial pay?
Jordan Lee: welcome aboard! Our rule: benefits effective first of the month after 30 days of FT service. With FT start 2024-02-10, effective date is 2024-03-01. Match and pre-tax deductions apply only to wages after that date (contractor invoices not eligible).
Sam Rivera: payroll posts 2/28 and 3/15 in my case. Can I get HSA on the 2/28?
Jordan Lee: payroll cutoff is 23:59 PT on the 5th and 20th. To hit the 2/28 pay you'd need enrollment submitted by 2024-02-20 23:59 PT. Otherwise deductions start on the first paycheck after 3/1 (likely 3/15).
Sam Rivera: any chance of retro match for contractor pay? I have invoices if needed.
Jordan Lee: only if there was an admin/payroll classification error (should have been W-2). If so, open a ticket with payroll + benefits and attach docs. We don't retro-match genuine 1099 contractor earnings.
Sam Rivera: got it, thanks. Which form do I use?
Jordan Lee: use the Conversion Enrollment form: https://redwood/hr/forms/conversion-enrollment. If you submit before 2024-02-20 23:59 PT we can aim for 2/28 pay; otherwise expecting 3/15. I can flag payroll after you submit.
Benefits Bot: Enrollment received for Sam Rivera. Ref ENR-20240220-112.
